seed_method: secrets.randbits(64), random.Random(seed); no project candidate access

random_draw.activity: aligning a damaged transparency beneath a manual projector

concept: Last-ferry optical technician pauses while aligning a damaged navigation transparency beneath a manual projector; salt streaks on the porthole and a repaired tear on the illuminated slide tie weather delay, work and present response into one frame.
reference_scope: Visible facial appearance cues only: dark round-oval eyes, fine brows, softly tapered face, small nose, gently full lips. Hair is explicitly redesigned by the agent. No actual identity, age, biography, personality or body similarity is inferred.

alternatives_compared.reason: Clear geometry but loses the requester-authorized complex lived situation.
Wind would displace edges and hide the cut geometry needed for an interpretable test.
An occupied work moment with a porthole, manual projector and repaired slide stays connected while still hair and controlled light make length zones readable.

visible_conditions.condition: Short dense blunt micro-fringe forms a continuous horizontal edge on the upper forehead, leaving a visible band of forehead above both eyebrows.
A smooth upper bob shell ends in a blunt edge at the jaw on both visible sides.
confusions: whole hairstyle a single long length
merely tucked long hair posing as a bob

visible_conditions.condition: Two loose lower hair panels emerge from beneath the short upper shell and extend clearly below the clavicles to the upper chest.
confusions: detached extensions floating away from the head

visible_conditions.condition: The upper jaw-length edge and the much longer lower panels show a crisp, large length discontinuity, with both levels visible together on the same head.
confusions: ordinary long hair with a few short face-framing strands
two people owning separate hair zones

visible_conditions.condition: Full fringe, both jaw-level edges, shoulder landmarks and lower-panel ends are in the same sharp native frame and unobscured by hands, hats, window edges or props.
confusions: neckline or apron merges with hair
one zone hidden behind the face

camera_visibility.view: near-front three-quarter head-and-mid-torso view, head yaw about 15 degrees, viewer at face height
camera_visibility.crop: complete crown with modest headroom through mid torso; both clavicles and long-panel endpoints included
camera_visibility.lighting: soft porthole side light with quiet fill; warm lower projector lamp remains subordinate
camera_visibility.contrast: ochre apron behind dark lower panels; quiet pale wall behind upper bob; controlled shiny strands
camera_visibility.body_action: both hands work on a waist-height slide tray below all hair endpoints; the head lifts to meet the viewer while the shoulders remain oriented to the bench

pixel_rule: all-of A1 through A5; PASS only when every condition is visible and satisfied; FAIL for a visible contradiction; UNOBSERVABLE_NOT_PASS for hidden or ambiguous evidence
independence_boundary: Only current task, supplied reference, current SKILL.md and exact neutral precore inputs used. No old research, other arm, source dictionaries, profile, semantic index, tests, candidate pack or earlier prompt was accessed before freeze.
